fix_from_suggestions.best_suggestion: Increase `compute-resources` ResourceQuota headroom to unblock surge pod
fix_from_suggestions.reason: Raising the quota's requests.memory to 232Mi (or setting maxSurge 0 / maxUnavailable 1) directly matches the acceptable fixes and removes the quota exhaustion blocking the new ReplicaSet's pod creation.
